zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 8; they obstruct downward and partial horizon views for Decks 8-11, with Deck 8 having the most severe obstruction.
zones.effect: Balcony and ocean view cabins look directly at or over lifeboat tops instead of open water; the view improves progressively on higher decks as you see past the boats.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to anyone who wants unobstructed ocean views and is booking ocean view or balcony cabins; interior cabin guests are unaffected.

zones.what: Deck 17 above houses interior cabins and some public spaces in the forward and midship sections.
zones.effect: Potential for footfall noise from guests in cabins or corridors directly overhead, though both decks are primarily accommodation so activity is similar.
zones.mattersTo: Light sleepers may notice evening foot traffic; most guests will not be bothered as both decks serve the same purpose.

zones.what: The main pool deck and Lido buffet area are located on Deck 16 aft, directly below or one deck below parts of the aft accommodation.
zones.effect: Daytime activity, music, and crowd noise from the pool area can carry to cabins above, particularly during the day and early evening.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to anyone planning to nap or relax in their cabin during the day; those out exploring won't notice.

zones.what: The main theatre (Deck 4) sits directly below the forward section of Deck 5.
zones.effect: Late-night shows can produce bass and vibration that carries upward, typically until 10-11 PM.
zones.mattersTo: Early sleepers should avoid this zone; night owls and those attending shows anyway will not care.

zones.what: These are the lowest guest decks in the aft section, closest to propulsion machinery.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum are perceptible underway, more noticeable at higher speeds or maneuvering.
zones.mattersTo: Sensitive sleepers or those who want absolute quiet should avoid; many guests adapt quickly or don't notice.

zones.what: Lowest forward cabins are near bow thruster machinery and anchor chain mechanisms.
zones.effect: Bow thrusters create vibration during docking/undocking; anchor chains rattle early morning in port.
zones.mattersTo: Light sleepers arriving in port at dawn will hear the anchor; others sleep through or are already awake.

zones.what: Primary elevator banks run through forward and midship sections across all guest decks.
zones.effect: Cabins immediately adjacent to elevator lobbies get convenient access but also hear chimes, doors, and conversation throughout the day and evening.
zones.mattersTo: Mobility-limited guests benefit from proximity; those sensitive to hallway noise should request cabins mid-corridor.

zones.what: The superstructure steps outward past the lifeboat line in the midship sections of Decks 10 and 11, creating extended balconies.
zones.effect: These balconies extend wider than the hull below, offering better sightlines past the lifeboats and a more open feel; they're also midship where motion is minimal.
zones.mattersTo: Value-conscious cruisers get better views for less money; those who want high decks or specific locations may not find them here.
